omni_master_prompt: Create ONE vertical 9:16 Spanish UGC documentary leaf clip with native spoken audio. Use the attached first frame as the exact visual source of truth. Preserve the same young male founder, warm modern real-estate office, clothing, lighting, devices, and physical layout. The founder documents rather than presents. Natural Mexican Spanish, calm and observant with growing quiet amazement, never a sales-announcer voice. One location, one camera setup, one visual action, and one exact spoken line per leaf. Keep the office alive with coworkers, desks, glass, plants, hallways, reflections, ambient keyboard and phone sounds. Handheld iPhone 15 Pro Max realism, 24fps feeling, micro focus hunting, tiny exposure shifts, no tripod, no digital zoom, no cinematic grading. Never call the system AI, GPT, chatbot, assistant, or automation. No montage inside a leaf, no repeated dialogue, no cut-off sentence, no extra limbs, no fake device, no floating object, no captions, no social UI, and no invented company logos.

concepts.caption: Parecía otra mañana normal en la oficina hasta que entró Mariana. Lo extraño no fue la llamada: fue todo lo que ocurrió después sin detener al equipo. Comenta SISTEMA y te enseño el flujo completo.
